title: Tenchi Muyo! Ryo-Ohki Season 2
native: 天地無用! 魎皇鬼 第2期
synopsis:
This OVA series gives the viewer more in-depth details on Sasami, Washu, and Ryo-ohki, as well as introducing members of the Juraian royal family.

(Source: Anime News Network)

episodes.title: Hello Baby!
episodes.synopsis: Tenchi thinks back to the strange occurrences in his life that have led him to this point, Ryo-Ohki gets lost in the wilderness, and the Masaki household encounters and unexpected visitor!

episodes.title: Sasami and Tsunami
episodes.synopsis: Tenchi's sister reveals some startling news: Tenchi has a new fiancee! How will Ryoko and the rest of the girls react!?

episodes.title: I Love Tenchi
episodes.synopsis: When stress leaves Tenchi confined to his bed, his new fiancee attempts to nurse him back to health! Meanwhile, Mihoshi makes plans to return home!

episodes.title: The Advent of the Goddess
episodes.synopsis: Mihoshi's brother vows to kill Tenchi for making his beloved sister part of a harem, and the housemates prepare a special meal for the arrival of Lady Seto!

episodes.title: Zero Ryoko
episodes.synopsis: While Ryoko and Ryo-Ohki do battle against the Chobimaru, Mashisu must turn her attention the strong feelings she has for Misao!

episodes.title: Here Comes Jurai
episodes.synopsis: Tenchi and Z meet in an intergalactic battle for the ages. When Tsunami and Washu get involved, the conflict threatens to destroy the entire universe!
